decisions.statement: A start is given the slots a seat's name is composed from rather than a name.
The slots compose the name a fresh seat takes.
Every word said here is read from the arguments this page names.
A lone word where this takes none is read as a seat name wherever it sits.
A call refused more than once is a mistyped flag rather than a name.
A stated parent is refused with the environment it is read from instead.
A help flag is answered from this page rather than by the code.
The code a start runs is reached only once a start is read.
The output a start prints is written where the start runs.
A start prints the agent's id on the output stream.
A start refused after it bound the name names each write it finished.
A start refused before it wrote anything is refused as the fault alone.
A headless start naming no prompt and no prompt file is refused.

definition: the command composing a fresh seat from the slots named after it
